ORDER TO SHOW CAUSE FOR CHANGE OF NAME
Off Calendar Mar-20-2007 Granted Per Written Order
MINI MINUTES: This cause came on regularly as scheduled for OSC hearing for Change of Name of a Minor.
Commissioner: Sue Kaplan, Clerk: S. Ravinantapricha, CSR: F. Butler.
Petitioner: Victoria Bao, present in pro per as Guardian ad litem for the Minor: Jasmine Choi, and with Cantonese Interpreter: Joe Lam.
Petitioner and Interpreter were sworn and examined.
No objections to the proposed change of name were made at the hearing.
It appears to the satisfaction of the Court that all the allegations in the petition are true, correct, and sufficient and that the petition should be granted.
The Court grants the petition for Change of Name of a Minor to: Jasmine Bao.
Decree signed in open court.

ORDER TO SHOW CAUSE FOR CHANGE OF NAME
Off Calendar Jan-25-2007 Text Ruling
MINI MINUTES: This cause came on regularly as scheduled for OSC hearing for Change of Name of a Minor.
Commissioner: Sue Kaplan, Clerk: Gina Gonzales, CSR: Angie Diner.
Petitioner: Victoria Bao, present in pro per as Guardian ad litem for the Minor: Jasmine Choi, and with Cantonese Interpreter: Nelson Mok, were sworn and examined.
Lacks the Minor's Father consent and/or proof of service or notice, the OSC for Change of Name of a Minor: Jasmine Choi, is continued to Mar. 20, 2007 at 9:00 a.m. in Dept. 218.
Petitioner to file an Amended Order to Show Cause and submit proof of service to the Minor's father of the new hearing date.
